root_cause: Escape key handling in dropdown.js always calls preventDefault and stopPropagation, preventing the modal from receiving the Escape key when the dropdown is not open.
repair_strategy: Modify dropdown.js's dataApiKeydownHandler to only prevent default and stop propagation for Escape when the dropdown is shown (isActive true); otherwise allow the event to propagate so the modal can close.
expected_accessibility_effect: Users can dismiss the share modal with Escape when focus is on the access toggle button and dropdown is closed, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard accessibility and providing a consistent Escape-to-close behavior.
functional_risks: May affect other components that rely on Escape being blocked when dropdown is closed.
Could interfere with browser-level Escape shortcuts if dropdown is used elsewhere.
verification_requirements: Press Escape with focus on access toggle when dropdown closed should close modal (make #access-toggle not visible).
Press Escape with focus on access toggle when dropdown open should close only dropdown (toggle remains visible).
ArrowDown and Space should still open dropdown.
Keyboard navigation within dropdown menu should remain functional.
Modal's static backdrop Escape behavior should remain unchanged.
